note: Mikazuki stats and scaling, 8 Oct 2026. Source of truth is combat-classes/combat-guide.md ('Stats, levels and scaling'). Numbers marked placeholder are for tuning.

requirements.checks: base stats only (growth + spent points), never gear bonuses

critRate.note: Repo addition (Mac, 11 Oct 2026): perDEX 0.001 -> 0.003, so DEX is worth a point like STR (HP, DEF) and INT (MP): a Lv 20 DEX main reaches about 25% crit rate (was about 12%); still held to caps.critRate.

damage.formula: power * skillPct * (1 + damageAmp) * crit * 100 / (100 + targetDEF) * levelGap

mobXpAbove20.rule: xp = round(toNext(mobLevel) / 50 * xpMult) for mobs of Lv 21+; the Slums formula stays for Lv 1-20 mobs

scrapheap-golem.xpTo: everyone who did at least 5% of its HP
scrapheap-golem.note: skillMult junkDrop and shockwave are repo additions (bot web/town-golem.ts): Junk Drop falls in circles under the players it isn't fighting, Shockwave rings out round a Tire Slam from half HP

payong-flapper.note: passive; opens to block (takes 50% damage from the front for 1 s), then pokes

garapon-jars.note: packs of 3; pull one, the pack comes

sako-slammer.note: belly slam leaves spilled rice: -30% move speed for 3 s

monobloc-stack.note: ranged chair throw (4 tiles); loses a chair at 60% and 30% HP (-10% ATK each)

sangkalan-chomper.note: blocks 50% of damage from the front; hit its sides

banyera-lurker.note: hidden in floodwater until 2 tiles away; first hit from hiding x1.5

timbangan-sentinel.note: Weigh: +1% damage per 2% of the target's current HP (x1.5 at full HP)

great-scale.xpTo: everyone who did at least 5% of its HP
great-scale.phases: calls 3 Timbangan Sentinels at 50% HP; enrages at 25% HP (red needle, +30% attack speed)

skills.tier: place in the class's damage-skill unlock order, 1-based

mpCost.rules: Costs at skill Lv 1 (+3% per skill level, see perSkillLevel). Tier 1 is free. Low-INT classes pay less so every class empties a full bar in about 30 s of nonstop casting at Lv 20. 5-minute buffs cost about a quarter of the bar; stances are free.

buffs.note: Buff numbers (Mac, 9 Oct: 'make it balance'). value is at skill Lv 1; +5% of it per skill level (perSkillLevel.buffDebuff), so a Lv 10 buff at its Lv 20 cap (skill Lv 11) gives 1.5x, a Lv 14 buff 1.3x, a Lv 20 buff 1x. MP costs are in mpCost.buffs. One-ally buffs are stronger than party buffs of the same stat.

rules.sameStat: Two buffs on the same stat do not add up: only the stronger one counts (both timers keep running). Different stats stack.
rules.stackNote: Repo addition (Mac, 10 Oct 2026): buffs stack. With stack true, different buffs on the same stat add up (Rally and Vital Rub: both count), still held to the caps; the same buff never stacks with itself (casting it again restarts it). false = sameStat's rule.
rules.recast: Casting a buff again restarts its timer.
rules.where: Buffs can only be cast on battle maps (like MP); they end when you leave the map or are knocked out.
rules.allyBuffsReachPartyNote: Repo addition (Mac, 10 Oct 2026): a one-ally buff (ally+self) reaches the caster's whole party within partyRangeTiles, plus the player they've picked, like a party buff; false = one ally (allyTarget)
rules.allyTarget: one ally + self: the selected party member within partyRangeTiles, else the nearest one; with no party member near, only yourself
rules.maxHp: raising max HP raises current HP by the same amount; when it ends, HP above the new max drops to it
rules.accuracy: points off the miss chance (the level gap gives 5 points a level the target is above you); never below 0
rules.defRate: percent less damage taken, after DEF; held to caps.defRate

Soothing Touch.note: an instant heal, not a timed buff: self + party members in range, Power x 80% (+2% a skill level, perSkillLevel.damageOrHeal, like heals)

statKeys.hpRegenPctPerSec: HP regen, % of max HP a second, in combat too
statKeys.evasion: mobs' miss chance on you + points
statKeys.hpDrainPctPerSec: HP lost a second, % of max HP (never below 10%)
statKeys.slow: (debuff) the mob moves at this share of its speed
statKeys.taunt: (debuff) the mob fights the caster for this many seconds
statKeys.tauntAround: (debuff) every mob within this many tiles of the caster is taunted

cooldownByUnlock.note: Damage skill cooldown (s) at skill Lv 1, by unlock level (Mac, 9 Oct: longer cooldowns so the MP costs hold, a full bar lasts about 30 s of nonstop casting at Lv 20). Tier 1 keeps the game's 1 s. -1% a skill level past 1 (perSkillLevel.cooldown). Mobility moves keep their own cooldowns. Lv 21 to 40: a flat 15 s each (Mac, 20 Oct 2026: was 12, 15, 18, 20, 24, 26 s; a touch over Lv 18's 14 s, so no newer skill comes round sooner than an older one).

moveDodge.note: Repo addition (17 Oct 2026, Mac): a mobility move that dodges every hit landing within its ms of being used (100% dodge: no damage, slow, stun or blindness; shown as Dodge). Step Back: the Slingshot's and Stick's Lv 8 move.

skills.rule: higher-tier skill at Lv 5 always beats a lower-tier skill at Lv 20
skills.unlocksAbove20: new damage skills at Lv 21, 25, 28, 32, 36, 40 (6 per class, separate track); cooldownByUnlock tiers 8-13 = 15 s each (Mac, 20 Oct: was 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26 s); skill level cap formula unchanged (max 20)

affixes.note: [blue, orange] max per LINE at item level R; stat = wearer main stat

lines.3: random from slot pool; rare stats only here

names.note: [blue, orange] affix names (combat-guide.md Affixes), from line 3; stat = the wearer's main stat

gearBudget: best set (dark orange, 2 agimats, +20) about 1.75x damage or 1.5x HP vs plain white gear; check with check_budget.py

enhancement.affects: weapons and armor: item base ATK / DEF; accessories: their affix value
enhancement.buffNote: Repo addition (Mac, 11 Oct 2026): the high pluses give more. Weapons and armor +3% of base a plus to +10, +8% to +15, +15% at +16, +20% from +17 to +20 (165% at +20; was 2/3/5%, 60%); armor at least +1 DEF a plus to +10, +3 to +15, +5 to +18, +7 at +19 and +20 (armorMinDEF, 13 Oct 2026; was +1 from +11, +2 from +17: its small base made a plus worth nothing); accessories' lines +2% a plus to +10, +4% to +15, +10% at +16, +12% from +17 (98% at +20; 13 Oct 2026, was +2% to +16, +5% from +17, 52%; before that +1%, 20%). The odds and whetstones are unchanged.

onFail.16to20: item breaks: keeps level, unusable until a Repair Kit of its tier

repairKits.note: Repo addition (Mac, 11 Oct 2026): Repair Kits of its tier a broken item takes, by the + it kept (a fail trying for +16 leaves it broken at +15, …, for +20 at +19).

weaponAura.appliesTo: weapons only, in hand and resting, all directions, visible to everyone; also the item icon

tiers.prismatic: all colours at once by angle around the weapon, turning slowly; each spiral line its own colour

weaponAura.style: code-drawn steady 3px glow outside the weapon (ring 1 full aura colour, ring 2 50%, ring 3 25%), weapon outline tinted, NO pulse/blink

smoke.look: spiral: lines wind around the weapon ~1.5 turns while rising from its bottom, fade ~18px above its top; back half hidden behind the weapon
smoke.trailLength: long lines trail about 1.5 turns of the spiral, short ones about a third of that

dropPlus.about: the plus a dropped piece of gear comes with (mob drops and golem loot alike), never more than +3

cascade.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): every pick of a tier (a dropped piece's rarity, plus and level, a boss piece's affix and slots, a dig's rarity) is a cascade: the best tier is tried first with its own chance (its weight over what's left of the table from it down: the same odds as the table), a miss tries the next, the floor always lands. Drop rate (the stat; caps.dropRate) raises every chance but the floor's and every chance of an extra item (a kill's gear and potion, a boss's accessory, agimat, hat, ticket) by dropRate × perChance, never over 1; never digs or event loot.

rarity.accessories: field boss only, blue/orange; about 1 in 3 golem loots

combatRating.note: Repo addition (Mac, 10 Oct 2026): the combat rating (CP) shown in the HUD, the stats box, the player box and Info: offense (Power, crits averaged in, x damage amp x attack rate) x offense + toughness (HP x (100 + DEF) / 100, / (1 - DEF rate)) x toughness + MP x mp, a class's offense x its reach. At Lv 20 in training gear (points in the main stat) every class is about 1,200 to 1,450.
combatRating.balanceNote: Repo addition (Mac, 11 Oct 2026): toughness 1 -> 0.4 and the ranged classes' offense x reach (they hit from 5 tiles, so they take fewer hits than the rating's HP shows): the classes' spread at Lv 20 in training gear went from 47% to 20%.

look.note: Repo addition (Mac, 10 Oct 2026): an agimat's picture is drawn darker the lower its level: `darkest` brightness at the first of `levels`, the art's own at the last (the top gear level), rising fastest at the start (a square root: Lv 20 about 0.70, Lv 50 0.85).

onlyIn.note: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): these agimats go only into gear of these slots (embedding refuses the rest; disassembly never rolls one for a slot it can't go in).

agimats.valueAtLevelNote: Repo change (Mac, 22 Oct 2026): agimats grow with their level. The flat stats twice as fast (was atk 0.1A+1, hp 0.36A+1, mp and def 0.25A+1, stat 0.05A+1); the rates with level, the same as before at Lv 10 (was a flat 1%, crit damage 4%): a Lv 20 agimat about twice a Lv 10's. Still held to the caps.
agimats.perItem: any stats, the same one in both slots too (rare ones: up to rarePerItem)
agimats.perItemNote: Repo addition (12 Oct 2026): was 'different stats'; two of the same stat add up
agimats.rarePerItemNote: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): how many rare agimats (crit rate, crit damage, damage amp) one item may hold; was 1 (the guide's 'at most one rare')

sellKusing.note: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): an agimat sells from the combat bag for perLevel x its level Kusing (a rare stat: x rareTimes; a stack: each)

agimats.slotLock: agimats from disassembly only fit the slot type they came from; dropped agimats fit any slot

mid.note: Mid tier opens with the palengke: Lv 30 gear (Bronze, Linen, Bamboo, Fine, Amber) and Lv 40 (Iron, Denim, Rattan, Polished, Jade); Polished Whetstone and Mid Repair Kit.

currencies.kusingPerMobRangeAbout: a kill drops a random whole number of Kusing between these times kusingPerMob (rounded): a Tin Can 60-120
currencies.kusingPerMobNote: formula unchanged: Payong Flapper 466, Timbangan Sentinel 1369

fragments.formulaNote: Repo change (13 Oct 2026): only gear with a + gives fragments (+1: 3, +5: 30, as many as its plus took in whetstones x 3); a +0 piece none (was 2 + 3 x them)
fragments.name: <Tier> Whetstone Fragment

agimat.from: affix items (blue, orange) with agimat slots only, at most 1: chance by affix tier

chance.note: Repo-only (11 Oct 2026; was: every slotted item, always 1): brown, white and grey give none

agimat.lockedToSlot: slot type of the dismantled item

death.respawn: gate of the map you entered through

party.xp: shared among nearby members, +10% per extra member, max +30%
party.xpNote: Repo addition (10 Oct 2026): every kill's XP is shared equally between the killer's party members in the same map within xpRangeTiles (the knocked out too), the total raised by xp's bonus; bosses keep their own rule (full XP to everyone who did their share)
party.loot: first come within the party; opens to all after 10 s
party.solo: killer only for 10 s, then anyone
party.boss: personal loot for everyone with >=5% damage, visible only to them

potions.sellShareNote: Repo addition (13 Oct 2026): HP and MP Potions sell from the combat bag for this share of their tier's kusing (Low 25, Medium 75 each), as many of a stack as you pick
potions.separateCooldownsNote: Repo addition (Mac, 10 Oct 2026): HP and MP Potions each have their own cooldown of sharedCooldownSec (an HP Potion never holds back an MP one); false = one shared

inventory.agimatSlotsNote: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): agimats have their own pocket of this many slots (the inventory's Agimats tab) and don't take the bag's; 0 = they share the bag's slots
inventory.costumeSlotsNote: Repo addition (Mac, 12 Oct 2026): cosmetics (the Lamp-head Hat) have their own pocket of this many slots (the inventory's Costume tab) and don't take the bag's; 0 = they share the bag's slots
stack99: consumables (Warren Tickets, Return Lanterns: repo addition)
inventory.questSlotsNote: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): quest items (Aling Nena's binoculars, the Lumang Palengke's) have their own pocket of this many slots (the inventory's Quest tab) and don't take the bag's

trainingGear.givenBy: Tanod on class choice (quest A Weapon for the Town)
trainingGear.retroactive: players who already finished the quest get the armor set once on next login (flag trainingArmorGiven)
trainingGear.sellNote: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): training gear sells from the combat bag for sellKusing Kusing a piece (it still can't be traded, enhanced or taken apart)
trainingGear.classChange: swap owned training weapon and armor for the new class ones

mobBehaviour.sameAsNote: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Silong's frost recolours live as their originals (aggressive or not, pack assist, reach).
mobBehaviour.aliveperZoneInNote: Repo addition (Mac, 20 Oct 2026): a map's own count per zone (the Lumang Palengke's zones are about 4x a Slums zone); a kind's mobs/mobs.json `alive` wins over both (the Garapon Jars' 10 packs, the Banyera Lurkers' 14).

golem.hpMinNote: Repo addition (13 Oct 2026): the least HP it has, however few players are in the Slums: its HP is the mob table's x hpPerPlayer^(players), but never under this (0 or left out: no floor)
golem.hpPerPlayerNote: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): its HP is the mob table's x hpPerPlayer^(players in the Slums), kept up to date as they come and go (its HP % stays)

targetPriority.note: Repo addition (Mac, 9 Oct 2026): who mobs go for first. An aggressive mob takes the highest within its aggroTiles (then the nearest); any mob in a fight switches to a higher one who comes within aggroTiles of it; the golem takes the highest in its fight (then whoever hit it last, then the nearest). Same priority never steals a mob.

lootRoll.note: Repo addition (12 Oct 2026): rare loot dropped for several players (a party's kill, a Scrap Warrens run) is rolled for instead of lying there: a pop-up each, Roll or Pass, `seconds` to decide, rolls 1..max, the highest wins it (in their bag); everyone passing leaves it on the ground for them. Which items: `tier` affix items named by one of these stats (the third line names an item: of Calamity = critRate/critDmg, of Flamboyance = amp, of Bloodlust = lifesteal) with `gear.minSlots` agimat slots, or accessories named by `accessories.stats`.

greatScale.note: Same shape as the golem loot one tier up; no cosmetic drop (Mac)

pets.note: Pets (Mac, 14 Oct 2026). Values marked default are Claude's; Mac set the tree layout, Lv cap 20, Lv 1 start, XP from attacking monsters scaled by level, 20-30 days to max, Fairy Cha +2.3% drop rate, boxes sold in the sari-sari store for 100 Kowens (common) / 200 (Fairy Cha). Mac set the maxed values for ATK +9, damage amp +3.5%, crit damage +9%.

xp.target: about 25 days of 2 h hunting at Lv 20 on Scrap Crabs (Lv 13), 1 gain/s at 75% of the time; Lv 11 mobs about 30 days

pets.requiresMeans: every listed node at its max

fairy-cha.name: Fairy Cha
fairy-cha.glowNote: Repo addition (owner, 14 Oct 2026): a soft pink glow, like Kislap's.

follow.zigzagNote: Repo change (owner, 14 Oct 2026): a leg of the zigzag is this many tiles (was 3 half-tile steps; zigzagEveryStepsHover for the hovering pets: Fork of Jord, Kislap, Fairy Cha), and pets zigzag only when heading north or south on screen; anywhere else they walk straight on the nearest move sheet.

petCube.note: repo-only (16 Oct 2026): pet cubes, a bound item opened into a bound Lv 1 pet of the owner's choice (shared pets.ts openPetCube; the popup and the server both read `choices`). One entry a tier: a rare cube would be a second.

cosmeticShop.note: Mac, 19 Oct 2026: Kowens for a head or body cosmetic, or both as a set, in the shop's Cosmetics tab

palengke.note: Palengke mobs drop Lv 30 no-affix gear 3% of kills (brown 20 / white 35 / grey 45); the Lurker and the Sentinel drop Lv 40 pieces 30% of the time; Medium potions 5%
